skill_name: Provide the cause for the following display.
workflow: The cause of the decrease in density on your x-ray may be due to a weakening of the bones or to a decrease in calcium intake. Other potential causes could include thyroid problems which can cause an imbalance in calcium, vitamin D deficiency, autoimmune diseases, or medications that can interfere with the body's ability to absorb calcium. It's best to consult a doctor to determine the cause.
